title: 字形结构运动系统｜组件组字、分栏、物理碰撞与双行锁定
source_title: 单镜头文字分区｜H字母切屏与九词联动
summary: 用首个标题的字形组件生成分栏与运动骨架，后续短词分别承担冲击、网格、卡片与碰撞动作；限定调色和文字集合，最终所有层同时停止在双行锁定。
input_format: Declare a small exact text set, one restricted palette and one primary title before animation begins. + Build the primary title from visible components and reuse one of its letterform structures as the layout carrier. + Give each secondary word one distinct readable physical action inside the inherited structure. + Compress prior cards or grids into one central collision while preserving exact spelling. + Resolve all fragments into one complete terminal lockup and stop background, decoration and foreground together.
recommended_input: 只用米白、墨黑和一种钴蓝点色；散落线段向中心旋入并组装为准确主标题【NORTH LAB】。；轨道内只引入准确短词【ORBIT】【FIELD】【SIGNAL】：ORBIT 环绕一次，FIELD 在透视网格上复制，SIGNAL 正面撞入并停住。；碎片清场后把准确【LAB】置于准确【NORTH】上方，中间一条钴蓝横线；背景、刻度与前景同时停住1.2秒。
required_anchors: Declare a small exact text set, one restricted palette and one primary title before animation begins.
Build the primary title from visible components and reuse one of its letterform structures as the layout carrier.
Compress prior cards or grids into one central collision while preserving exact spelling.
Resolve all fragments into one complete terminal lockup and stop background, decoration and foreground together.
